# Remy's Lab

> Remy's Lab is a dog product testing page run by Josh and Remy, a yellow Labrador in Buffalo, NY. Every product featured has actually been tested by Remy before it's written up. The site is a simple, TikTok-driven link page: partner discount codes and honest test notes, not a full review blog or ecommerce store.

## What this site is
- A mobile-first link-in-bio style page for the TikTok account @remy.lab
- Partner discount codes for dog product brands, with copy-to-clipboard code buttons
- "Lab Notes" — short, honest test notes on products Remy has actually used, including what worked and what didn't

## What this site is not
- Not a full comparison or price-tracking tool
- Not an ecommerce store
- Not a traditional SEO content blog

## Pages
- / — Home: current partner codes and links
- /lab-notes.html — Test notes on products Remy has tried
- /disclaimer.html — Affiliate disclosure
- /privacy.html — Privacy policy
- /terms.html — Terms of use
